newsitem.title: USA: Zeneca fungicide gets U.S. registration.
newsitem.headline: Zeneca fungicide gets U.S. registration.

text.p: Zenaca Inc, a unit of Zeneca Plc, said Friday its fungicide azoxystrobin was granted U.S. registration by the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency and has been designated as a reduced risk pesticide.
The EPA approved the fungicide's use on turfgrass for the control of several diseases, the company said.
The turfgrass fungicide market was valued at about $150 million, the company said.
Zeneca said it was seeking further approvals for azoxystrobin in most major fruit, vegetable and row crop fungicide markets.
